**Subject: Order TH-48217 – missing delivery and request for resolution**

Dear Tiny Hands customer service team,

I’m writing about order TH-48217, which I placed on 21 October and paid for by card. The total was R1,640, including R95 for delivery.

Your courier’s tracking says the order was delivered on Tuesday, 3 November at 11:42 and signed for by “M. Adams”. It did not arrive at Bergview Pre-Primary in Plumstead, and nobody at the school is called Adams. Our gate guard, Uncle Faizel, keeps a book of every delivery, and there was no delivery recorded on 3 November. I’ve also checked that the delivery address on my order was correct.

The order contained six tubs of finger paint, four bags of playdough, 200 paper plates, googly eyes, glitter glue and two rolls of brown paper.

I emailed on 4 and 6 November and received the same reply both times: “we have escalated your query to our courier partner.” I then phoned on Friday and spent 38 minutes on hold, only to be told that nothing could be done until the courier finishes its investigation, which could take 10 working days.

I’m really frustrated that I’m being asked to wait while the courier investigates, with no practical solution in the meantime. I placed and paid for the order with Tiny Hands; I didn’t choose the courier. I understand that you need to find out what happened, but I shouldn’t be left to sort this out with the courier or indefinitely wait for an answer.

I bought these supplies with my own money for my class, and R1,640 is a lot to be out of pocket on a teacher’s salary. The children made their mask patterns last week, and I’ve spent the past week telling them the paint is “coming soon”. We also need the supplies to make props for our end-of-year concert on 27 November.

I’ve ordered from you three times before without any problems, which is why this experience has been so disappointing.

Please arrange **either a replacement of the complete order or a full refund of R1,640, including delivery, by Friday, 13 November**. Please also send me a proper response confirming which option you will provide and when, rather than another template saying the matter has been escalated.

If I don’t receive a meaningful response by then, I’ll pursue a chargeback with my bank and leave a review of my experience. I would much rather resolve this directly with you.

I look forward to hearing from someone who can help.

Kind regards,  
[Your name]  
[Your contact number]
